Insulin

Same organ. Opposite jobs.

Both from the pancreas

Beta

cells make insulin

Alpha

cells make glucagon

Both are peptides

51

amino acids, 2 chains

29

amino acids

Sugar high, after a meal

Insulin

1Muscle takes in glucose
2Liver releases less glucose

Sugar goes down

Sugar low, between meals

Glucagon

1Liver breaks down glycogen
2Liver makes new glucose

Sugar goes up

Discovery

1923

A pancreas extract raised blood sugar.

Kimball and Murlin named it “glucagon”.
